files.make_docx.py:
import sys
from docx import Document
doc = Document()
doc.add_heading("Quarterly report", level=1)
doc.add_paragraph("Made on the phone by a skill script, with python-docx.")
table = doc.add_table(rows=3, cols=2)
for i, (k, v) in enumerate([("Item", "Value"), ("Apples", "12"), ("Pears", "7")]):
    table.cell(i, 0).text = k
    table.cell(i, 1).text = v
doc.save(sys.argv[1])
back = Document(sys.argv[1])
print("paragraphs:", len(back.paragraphs), "tables:", len(back.tables))

from openpyxl import Workbook, load_workbook
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Sales"
ws.append(["Month", "Amount"])
for row in [("Jan", 120), ("Feb", 95), ("Mar", 143)]:
    ws.append(row)
ws["A5"] = "Total"
ws["B5"] = "=SUM(B2:B4)"
wb.save("sales.xlsx")
print("formula:", load_workbook("sales.xlsx")["Sales"]["B5"].value)

from pypdf import PdfWriter
for name, pages in (("a.pdf", 1), ("b.pdf", 2)):
    w = PdfWriter()
    for _ in range(pages):
        w.add_blank_page(width=595, height=842)
    with open(name, "wb") as f:
        w.write(f)
files.merge.py:
import sys
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
*inputs, out = sys.argv[1:]
w = PdfWriter()
for p in inputs:
    for page in PdfReader(p).pages:
        w.add_page(page)
with open(out, "wb") as f:
    w.write(f)
print("pages:", len(PdfReader(out).pages))

files.make_pdf.py:
import docx  # noqa: just to load lxml alongside
from pypdf import PdfWriter
from pypdf.generic import NameObject, DictionaryObject, ArrayObject, DecodedStreamObject, FloatObject
w = PdfWriter()
page = w.add_blank_page(width=300, height=200)
font = DictionaryObject({NameObject("/Type"): NameObject("/Font"), NameObject("/Subtype"): NameObject("/Type1"), NameObject("/BaseFont"): NameObject("/Helvetica")})
page[NameObject("/Resources")] = DictionaryObject({NameObject("/Font"): DictionaryObject({NameObject("/F1"): w._add_object(font)})})
stream = DecodedStreamObject()
stream.set_data(b"BT /F1 18 Tf 20 100 Td (Hello from a PDF) Tj ET")
page[NameObject("/Contents")] = w._add_object(stream)
with open("hello.pdf", "wb") as f:
    w.write(f)
